space.expression: At most 2^{n+o(n)} storage from the list algorithm

notes: The full theorem has runtime 2^{n+O(log n log f(n))}. The coefficient 1 requires the displayed growth restriction on f; this is a cutoff sampler rather than arbitrary-width shifted DGS.

extra.width: s > dist(t,L)/f(n), efficiently computable f(n) >= n^{omega(1)} and log f(n)=o(n/log n)
extra.output: At least m=rho_s(L-t)/max_{c in L/(2L)} rho_s(c-t) samples; m is instance- and width-dependent
extra.error: Joint total-variation error 2^{-C n^2}, source constant C
extra.model: Randomized classical; full list preparation included; polynomial input-size factors suppressed
